name: bequest
title: Bequest
description: A community-foundation theme whose donate block is a giant presentation cheque made out to your organisation — bank-green security border, written lines in a cheque-writer mono, the Donate link as the heavy amount box — on foamboard white, with the impact figure on its counterfoil.

tokens.--font-print: the printed face — headings, the site title, menu, captions on the cheque, table headings
tokens.--font-hand: the cheque-writer mono — everything written on the cheque, the impact figure, figures in tables, dates, tags, code and the Donate menu entry
tokens.--text-s: captions, dates, the footer, the words on the counterfoil
tokens.--text-m: body text and the amount-in-words line on a narrow cheque
tokens.--text-l: ledes, list titles, the amount-in-words line on a wide cheque and the figures in tables
tokens.--text-xl: section headings over the program list and the get-involved block
tokens.--text-xxl: page titles and the mission headline
tokens.--text-figure: largest size of the impact figure on the counterfoil; it shrinks to fit the counterfoil's width
tokens.--text-amount: size of the Donate word written in the amount box, scaled to the cheque's width
tokens.--text-payee: size of the site title written on the Pay line, scaled to the cheque's width
tokens.--leading-written: line height of every written line, and the spacing of the printed rules under it
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter-spacing of the printed capitals — captions, menu, site title, small headings
tokens.--color-face: the face of the cheque and its counterfoil, the gaps in the security hatching, the skip link
tokens.--color-text: marker-black ink — body text, headings, the amount-box frame, the signature line, rules under the masthead and above lists, the focus ring
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text — ledes, descriptions in lists, dates, the footer, the code line along the foot of the cheque
tokens.--color-accent: bank green — the cheque's security hatching, border and printed captions, the rules under written lines, the counterfoil's perforation, the faint guilloche behind the cheque face, links, the current-page marker, tag frames
tokens.--color-tint: the pale green behind written lines, code and hovered boxes (deep green at night)
tokens.--color-rule: hairlines between list rows and table rows, the menu hover underline
tokens.--color-edge: the foamboard thickness drawn under the cheque's lower right edge
tokens.--band: width of the cheque's hatched security border, of the hatched footer strip and of a horizontal rule in text
tokens.--frame: thickness of the amount-box frame around the Donate word, and of the frame on the 404 page's Donate link
tokens.--rule-written: thickness of the printed rule under each written line
tokens.--focus-ring: thickness of the keyboard focus ring, the current-page underline and the frame of the Donate menu entry
tokens.--tap-target: minimum height of menu links and other tap targets
tokens.--tilt: how far the mission page's cheque is turned, as if held up for the photographer; on wide screens only
tokens.--edge-depth: depth of the foamboard edge under the cheque
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the cheque — barely any
